changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud Remote Skills Connector.

- Enables client-side discovery, authentication, A2A communication, and task management for Alibaba Cloud AgentHub-hosted skills.
- Supports user requests to inspect, manage, and troubleshoot Alibaba Cloud resources via remote Agents, using strict command boundaries.
- Handles all user interactions, progress updates, and explanations in Simplified Chinese.
- Enforces strong security: never executes local Alibaba Cloud commands, never requests sensitive credentials, and requires strict HTTPS verification.
- Implements a cryptographically random 32-character session ID for every conversation, reused in all operations.
- Provides detailed guidance for agent script invocation, credential management, user agent string usage, and session ID normalization across supported clients.
summary: Use when a user asks what the Alibaba Cloud Remote Skills Connector can do, which hosted Alibaba Cloud skills are currently available, or requests Alibaba Cloud capability onboarding; wants to inspect, query, diagnose, audit, create, deploy, configure, update, resize, restart, repair, restore, or delete Alibaba Cloud (阿里云/Aliyun) resources; uses Chinese triggers such as 查询, 诊断, 巡检, 创建, 删除, 更新, 升配, 扩缩容, 重启, and 修复; continues an existing AgentHub task; or troubleshoots this connector's discovery/authentication—even without a product name. Exclude other clouds, general knowledge/architecture/pricing questions, and requests for local CLI/SDK/OpenAPI/Terraform/ROS execution or code.
